senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.Gabbath, later name for Biblical Gibbethon, in the territory of Dan. [Cmp. as to change of Biblical names Y. Meg. I, 70ᵃ bot.] Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ; Ruth R. introd.; Cant. R. to I, 16 מג׳ ועד אנטיפרס וכ׳ between G. and Antipatris there were sixty myriads of townships; Y. Meg. l. c. מגבות; Lam. R. to II, 2 מגיבתון.
